treatment_summary.value: Antihistamines (levocetirizine, cetirizine, fexofenadine, loratadine) did not suppress urticaria; prednisone and steroid injections were the only treatments that cleared the hives; prednisone eventually stopped due to side effects. Authors suggest a future trial of anti-IgE therapy (omalizumab).

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Referred at 34 years of age for severe angioedema and chronic urticaria; mastocytosis considered for elevated tryptase but criteria not met (absence of mast cells in bone marrow biopsy; CT ruled out visceral involvement); ultimately diagnosed with chronic urticaria. WES (Agilent Clinical Research Exome, GeneDx) with capillary sequencing confirmation found a heterozygous TNFAIP3 VUS.

functional_evidence_statement.value: No functional assay reported (authors state functional analyses will be necessary). In silico: absent from ExAC, 1/30936 genomes in gnomAD; Arg22 conserved to zebrafish; PredictSNP2 deleterious score 1.0000, CADD 22.6000, FATHMM 0.9806. Molecular modeling: p.R22Q gives a net increase in free energy of 0.755 kcal/aa*mol*Å^2 (possibly locally destabilizing) and altered electrostatic distribution around position 22.
